summary: Added a Macro Library pop-up window for browsing and loading shared team macros from the ArcRho Server.
details: The macro panel header has a Library button that opens a separate floating Macro Library window listing shared macros from the server's shared\macros folder with version, release note, and install status (New, Update, Loaded, Differs).
Load copies the selected macro into your local macros folder; a differing local copy asks before it is replaced.
Macros continue to run only from your local macros folder, so an unreachable library never blocks existing macros.
